variantBlurb.holdem: 2 hidden cards + 5 shared cards. The most popular poker game. No-limit: bet as much as you like.
variantBlurb.omaha: 4 hidden cards; you must use exactly 2 of them + 3 from the board. Pot-limit: raise at most the size of the pot.
variantBlurb.fiveCardDraw: 5 hidden cards and one chance to swap some of them. Fixed-limit: bet sizes are fixed.
variantBlurb.sevenCardStud: No shared cards; everyone gets 7 cards, 4 of them face up. Fixed-limit, starts with antes and a bring-in.

personalityHelp.tight: Plays few hands, continues only with good cards.
personalityHelp.balanced: Neither too careful nor too bold.
personalityHelp.loose: Stays in many hands and calls a lot.
personalityHelp.maniac: Bets and raises often, loves to bluff.

setup.title: Set up the game
setup.lead: You play against bots with practice chips, not real money. Every move is explained.
setup.stepHint: Press "Next" for every deal and every bot move. Ideal for beginners.
setup.autoHint: Bots play on their own and stop when it is your turn.
setup.notPlayable: This game can't be played at the table yet. Pick a playable one below.

bar.toCall: You need to put in {{amount}} chips to stay in
bar.free: Nobody has bet: you can continue for free (check)
bar.nextHint: Advance one step (→ key works too)
bar.busted: You're out of chips. No problem, it's part of learning!
bar.tableWon: You knocked everyone out! Start a new game.
bar.drawTitle: Click the cards you want to swap
bar.drawHint: You can swap up to {{max}} cards. Selected cards are thrown away and replaced.

table.fallback: The 3D table couldn't start on this device; using the simple view.

coachUi.title: Coach
coachUi.off: Coach is off. Turn it on to get an explanation of what to do on every decision.
coachUi.waiting: You'll see advice here when it's your turn.
coachUi.equityHelp: Estimated by playing out 200 random scenarios.
coachUi.potOddsHelp: The minimum chance to win a call needs.
coachUi.noHandYet: You don't have 5 cards yet; your hand takes shape as the board comes out.
coachUi.noHandYetStud: You don't have 5 cards yet; your hand will take shape as new cards are dealt.
coachUi.noHandYetDraw: Your hand will take shape after you swap your cards.

coach.equity: Your chance to win this hand is about {{pct}}%. With {{opponents}} opponents, an average share would be {{fair}}%.
coach.potOdds: You'd put in {{toCall}} chips to win a pot of {{pot}}. So a call pays off if you win at least {{pct}}% of the time (this is called pot odds).
coach.betForValue: Your hand is stronger than average: bet so weaker hands pay you (a value bet).
coach.checkFree: Nobody has bet; checking to see the next card for free makes the most sense.
coach.foldBadOdds: Your chance to win is below what the pot is offering. Calling loses chips in the long run: fold.
coach.raiseStrong: Your hand is very strong: raise to build the pot.
coach.callOk: Your chances are worth the price: calling is reasonable.
coach.drawKeepAll: Your hand is already strong (or complete). Don't swap anything.
coach.drawDiscard: Keep the useful cards and swap {{n}}.

review.won: Well done! You won {{amount}} chips this hand.
review.folded: You folded, so you didn't lose any more chips this hand.
review.lost: You lost this hand. Your opponent had a stronger hand at showdown.
review.uncontested: {{name}} took the pot without showing cards because everyone folded.
review.passive: You called a lot but never bet or raised. Try taking the lead with strong hands.

log.title: What happened?
log.handStart: Hand #{{n}} started. The dealer button (D) is in front of {{name}}; dealing and action start to their left.
log.ante: {{name}} paid a {{amount}}-chip ante. An ante is a small forced fee everyone puts in at the start.
log.sb: {{name}} posted the small blind ({{amount}} chips), a small forced bet.
log.bb: {{name}} posted the big blind ({{amount}} chips). Anyone who wants to play must put in at least this much.
log.bringIn: {{name}} shows the lowest up card and posts a {{amount}}-chip bring-in (a forced opening bet).
log.dealHole: Everyone was dealt {{count}} hidden cards (hole cards). Only you can see yours.
log.dealCommunity: {{street}}: {{cards}} turned face up in the middle. Everyone can use these shared cards.
log.dealStud: {{street}}: everyone got {{up}} face-up and {{down}} face-down cards.
log.drawNone: {{name}} kept all cards (stand pat): their hand might already be good!
log.showdownSplit: Split pot: {{names}} have equally strong hands.
log.uncontested: Everyone folded; {{name}} took the pot ({{amount}} chips) without showing cards.

action.fold: {{name}} folded: gave up the cards and is out of this hand.
action.call: {{name}} called {{amount}}: matched the current bet. Pot: {{pot}}.
action.bet: {{name}} bet {{amount}}. Others must match it to stay in. Pot: {{pot}}.
action.raise: {{name}} raised: the bet is now {{to}}. Pot: {{pot}}.

notes.roundEnd: The {{street}} betting round is over; bets were collected into the pot.
notes.drawStarts: Time to draw: each player in turn throws away unwanted cards and gets new ones.
notes.toShowdown: The last betting round is over. The remaining players reveal their cards (showdown).
notes.allFolded: Everyone but one player folded; the hand ends without a showdown.
notes.bettingStarts: {{street}} betting round begins. First to act: {{name}}.
notes.noBetting: {{street}}: nobody can bet any more (all-in), so the cards keep coming.
